== Biography ==
Robert was born before 1674. He is the son of [[Glasgow-1496|James Glasgow]] and [[Orr-7027|Janet Orr]]. 
== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-1496]] is assessed at 99% (proved). Robert's 5 April 1674 Campbeltown transcript names father James Glasgow, maltman, and mother Janet Orr, residence Campbelltown. The transcript’s maltman occupation, Campbeltown residence and full James/Janet Orr couple identify the selected adult father. This is the Robert event formerly misplaced in James’s own parent evidence.

Confident for Robert’s father James; this record does not prove that George was James’s father.

Next useful test: Keep the generations distinct when reusing this baptism.

Source basis already held: [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=SCOT%2FOPR%2FBAP%2F3018209&tab=this Findmypast, Scotland, Parish Births & Baptisms 1564-1929: Robert Glasgow, 05 Apr 1674, record SCOT/OPR/BAP/3018209].
